entities.name: Separation of Powers
entities.label: Idea
entities.summary: The principle that governmental authority should be divided among distinct branches — legislative, executive, and judicial — each checking the others. Articulated by Montesquieu and embodied in the U.S. Constitution, this idea became the architectural blueprint for modern republican governments worldwide.
